name: Abijam
bio: Abijam was Rehoboam's son, who succeeded him as king of Judah after Rehoboam's seventeen-year reign ended and he was buried in the City of David (1 Kings 14:31). He reigned three years in Jerusalem; his mother was Maachah, daughter of Abishalom. Abijam committed all the sins his father had committed before him, and his heart was not fully devoted to the LORD as David's had been — yet for David's sake the LORD preserved a lamp for him in Jerusalem, raising up his son after him. There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam throughout his reign. When Abijam died, he was buried in the City of David, and his son Asa succeeded him (1 Kings 15:1-8).
